g.text: Larger island study B: a feasible coast-only box
Same original coast proportions as trial A; both islands shift 600 blocks west.
ACTIVE: Ice 25.2%, El Dorado 24.0% of mainland width
INERT STUDY B: Ice 41.5%, El Dorado 32.5%
Study B box: 13824 × 11264; dashed outline includes 1200-block outer sea and region rounding.
Nearest mainland sea: Ice 927.76 blocks; El Dorado 961.91 blocks. Active sites have not moved.
Feasible box is not full geography acceptance: island-size brief and internal layers still need review.
